capabilities: Intercepts external pastes and reformats them with toggleable rules
Converts clipboard HTML to Markdown using Obsidian's built-in engine
Fixes code fences, math delimiters, headings, and blank-line spacing
Strips emojis, trailing whitespace, and URL tracking parameters
Debugs pastes via a three-panel raw/formatted preview and raw-paste commands
extras: README documents known limitations (e.g., ChatGPT flattening Python code blocks) and includes a legacy-paste setting that restores prior 1.2.0 behavior.
problem: Text copied from AI chat interfaces pastes into Obsidian with excessive blank lines, bolded headers, broken code fences, AI-style math delimiters, emojis, and tracking URLs.
summary: Paste interceptor that converts clipboard HTML from AI chatbots into clean native Obsidian Markdown, applying customizable formatting rules before insertion.
